n2f8f5998b2.headline: Docusign Just Posted Strong Earnings--So Why Did the Stock Plunge 6% Overnight?
n2f8f5998b2.summary: Docusign shares plunged 6% overnight despite strong earnings, with AI integrations growing and cash flow rising. The report notes Wall Street's reaction to the results.
n2f8f5998b2.why: Docusign is a US electronic signature and agreement software company, and its shares reflect investor expectations for growth in software subscriptions.

nf485fdb6f1.headline: Poundland announces another wave of store closures over winter
nf485fdb6f1.summary: Budget retailer Poundland will have shut more than 100 UK shops by early next year after starting its restructuring programme. Another wave of closures is planned over winter.
nf485fdb6f1.why: Poundland is a UK discount variety retailer, and store closures reflect pressure on high-street retail and the cost of its restructuring.

n1bc697330f.headline: Korea’s Woori Bank Begins Displaying Bitcoin Price in Its Trading Room
n1bc697330f.summary: On December 5, South Korean bank Woori Bank began displaying Bitcoin prices in its main trading room in Seoul. The screen also shows won-dollar exchange rates and stock market data.
n1bc697330f.why: Woori Bank is one of South Korea's largest banks, and its adoption of crypto price displays signals growing mainstream financial-sector attention to digital assets.

n3dbeedb572.headline: Swiss Franc Loan Crisis: 80,000 Borrowers Appeal to Supreme
n3dbeedb572.summary: About 80,000 Greek borrowers with Swiss franc loans have brought their case to Areios Pagos. They seek repayment in euros, arguing that exchange clauses are abusive.
n3dbeedb572.why: Swiss franc mortgage and consumer loans in Greece were widely issued before the 2010s, and court rulings on currency clauses affect the balance sheets of Greek banks.

nf9862ea8eb.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Rises Amid European Gains
nf9862ea8eb.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange General Index rose 0.57%, mirroring positive trends across European markets.
nf9862ea8eb.why: The Athens exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its index tracks the performance of Greek listed companies.

nc26466f5f5.headline: Candy Factory buys majority of Italgum Caramelle
nc26466f5f5.summary: The Candy Factory, an Italian confectionery group, has taken a "majority" stake in Italgum Caramelle. The report gives no financial terms.
nc26466f5f5.why: Confectionery deals like this consolidate mid-sized candy makers, which can shift competitive positions in a fragmented sector.

n8eb57b18fa.headline: Rupee falls 5 paise to close at 89.94  against US dollar after RBI cuts repo rate
n8eb57b18fa.summary: The rupee closed 5 paise lower at 89.94 against the US dollar after the Reserve Bank of India cut its key benchmark rate for the first time, having given up early gains.
n8eb57b18fa.why: The rupee is India's currency, and the RBI repo rate is its main policy rate. Changes in policy rates affect yields and capital flows that drive the rupee.
n8eb57b18fa.why_moved: The rupee gave up early gains after the RBI cut its key benchmark rate for the first time. Lower policy rates typically reduce the appeal of rupee-denominated returns.

n6d6ce5a471.headline: ITT to Acquire SPX FLOW, Significantly Expanding Leadership Position in Highly Engineered Components and Adjacent Flow Technologies
n6d6ce5a471.summary: ITT is acquiring SPX FLOW, adding core and adjacent flow technologies. The deal is intended to strengthen ITT's positions in industrial, chemical and energy markets.
n6d6ce5a471.why: ITT is a US maker of engineered industrial components, and SPX FLOW supplies pumps and flow equipment. Acquisitions of this kind reshape market positions in industrial equipment.

nbe31ceba21.headline: Foxconn’s China exit due to erratic policies, signals MNCs shift to India, Vietnam
nbe31ceba21.summary: A sudden closure of a Foxconn plant in Hengyang, China, was reported to be due to government policies. A report says it signals multinationals shifting production toward India and Vietnam.
nbe31ceba21.why: Foxconn, formally Hon Hai Precision Industry, is Apple's largest assembler of iPhones. Production shifts away from China affect supply chains, costs and manufacturing investment decisions.

n5a7e46ab58.headline: Dajin Forms Offshore Wind Alliance with German Port Terminal Operator
n5a7e46ab58.summary: Dajin Heavy Industry and Germany's Briese Schiffahrt signed a memorandum of understanding to develop offshore wind marshalling. The agreement covers a port-based offshore wind project.
n5a7e46ab58.why: Offshore wind marshalling ports handle turbine components and vessels, making them a key link in the offshore wind supply chain.

nf6c4ccc6ae.headline: UK stocks post weekly declines as energy and financials lag
nf6c4ccc6ae.summary: The FTSE 100 edged lower on Friday and logged a sharp weekly decline, dragged down by energy and financial shares, even as expectations for a Fed rate cut next week held up.
nf6c4ccc6ae.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London, and energy and banks are heavy weights in it.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: The index fell on the day and logged a weekly decline, with energy and financial shares leading the losses.

n083ca7466e.headline: Economy has huge issues, billionaire retail icon warns
n083ca7466e.summary: Premier Investments shares plunged after the owner of Smiggle and Peter Alexander cut its earnings forecast. The company blamed the lower outlook on economic conditions, with its chief describing the economy as having huge issues.
n083ca7466e.why: Premier Investments is an Australian retail conglomerate listed on the ASX, operating brands such as Smiggle and Peter Alexander. Its earnings guidance is closely watched as a read on consumer spending in Australia.
n083ca7466e.why_moved: Shares fell sharply after the company cut its earnings forecast, which it attributed to lower earnings expectations.

n3a0d07c5ac.headline: Airbus Delivers 72 Aircraft in November, Receives 75 Gross Orders
n3a0d07c5ac.summary: Airbus delivered 72 aircraft in November, a figure nearly 10% lower than the same month in 2024. The company also received 75 gross orders, and the statement came two days after it revised its delivery guidance.
n3a0d07c5ac.why: Airbus is a European aerospace manufacturer and one of the two main producers of large commercial airliners. Monthly deliveries and order intake are key indicators of its revenue and the health of the aviation supply chain.

impacts.name: Airbus
impacts.why: Monthly deliveries and gross orders are a direct read on Airbus's aircraft sales and revenue.

n246c8afee3.headline: Business Matters – Ep 273: Auto-enrolment update - plus the Employee Small Benefit Tax Exemption, and the Donegal Business Network
n246c8afee3.summary: Ireland's auto-enrolment pension scheme, called My Future Fund, will begin on January 1, 2026, automatically enrolling eligible employees in a retirement savings plan.
n246c8afee3.why: Auto-enrolment expands workplace pension saving and affects long-term pension fund inflows and employer payroll obligations. It is a structural change to Irish retirement savings.

n2e3ca1e115.headline: Australian Market Swings To Slight Gains In Mid-market
n2e3ca1e115.summary: The Australian stock market swung to slight gains in mid-market moves on Friday, following mixed cues from Wall Street overnight.
n2e3ca1e115.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index and reflects the performance of the country's largest listed companies.

n81d03508d0.headline: CAC 40 Edges Higher Ahead of U.S. PCE Index Release
n81d03508d0.summary: The Paris market was up 0.3% around 8,150 points, supported by Edenred, Saint-Gobain and Stellantis. Investors were watching ahead of the U.S. PCE inflation data release.
n81d03508d0.why: The CAC 40 is the benchmark index of the largest listed companies on Euronext Paris. Its moves reflect French and broader euro-area equity sentiment.

impacts.name: CAC 40
impacts.why: The index was trading modestly higher in the morning session.

n1903ba7836.headline: Paris Edges Higher as Eyes Turn to U.S. Inflation
n1903ba7836.summary: The Paris stock exchange advanced cautiously, up 0.3% near 8,150 points, with gains in Edenred, Saint-Gobain and Stellantis. Investors were awaiting US inflation figures.
n1903ba7836.why: The CAC 40 is the benchmark index of major French listed companies and reflects the performance of the French equity market.

n971fdf1386.headline: Average UK house price at near standstill month-on-month in November – Halifax
n971fdf1386.summary: The typical UK property value rose by £138 month-on-month in November, a near standstill, but still reached a new record high, according to Halifax.
n971fdf1386.why: Halifax is a major UK mortgage lender whose house price index is a closely watched gauge of the housing market and household wealth.

n4b7835d324.headline: Gaja Alternative Asset Management files updated  draft papers; eyes Rs 656-cr via IPO
n4b7835d324.summary: Gaja Capital has filed updated draft papers with Sebi to raise a little over Rs 656 crore through an initial public offering.
n4b7835d324.why: Gaja Capital is an Indian alternative asset manager, and IPO filings show its plans to raise fresh capital through a public listing.

n9eb52a1341.headline: One area of the UK with 1.9 million people is seeing house prices rocket
n9eb52a1341.summary: Halifax data show average property prices stalled in November, though prices are falling in some areas and still surging in others.
n9eb52a1341.why: Halifax is a major UK mortgage lender, and its house price index is a widely followed gauge of the UK housing market.

nf43c6be7e9.headline: How trucking costs are changing, in 4 charts
nf43c6be7e9.summary: Rising expenses and flat rates have created a difficult environment for the trucking industry, which is already dealing with a lackluster market. The trend is illustrated in four charts.
nf43c6be7e9.why: Trucking moves a large share of US freight, so cost and rate trends are a read-through for goods demand and transport company margins.

n760c56ae69.headline: Pebblebrook sells Westin Michigan Avenue Chicago hotel for $72m
n760c56ae69.summary: Pebblebrook has sold the Westin Michigan Avenue Chicago hotel for $72 million. Proceeds will go to debt reduction and other corporate financial priorities.
n760c56ae69.why: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust is a US lodging real estate investment trust, and asset sales are a common way for such companies to manage their debt.

n9a2110c28e.headline: Capital Armies: Private Equity’s Encroachment on America’s Defense Frontier
n9a2110c28e.summary: Private equity firms are buying defense suppliers and technology companies with borrowed money, injecting capital and speed into military systems. The article examines how this reshapes defense funding in the United States.
n9a2110c28e.why: Private equity firms buy and restructure companies using debt, and their growing role in defense supply chains can affect contractors and national security procurement.

nc4f29ffea9.headline: Euroclear to go bust if Russian asset seizure plan executed — depository head
nc4f29ffea9.summary: Euroclear chief Valerie Urbain said the depository would go bust if the EU summit on December 18-19 approves the plan to seize Russian assets. She said Euroclear is ready to challenge it in court.
nc4f29ffea9.why: Euroclear is a Brussels-based securities depository holding large volumes of frozen Russian central bank assets, so any seizure plan directly affects its balance sheet.

nab4e47c85e.headline: EMEA Morning Briefing :  U.S. PCE Data in Focus
nab4e47c85e.summary: European stock futures traded higher early Friday as markets focused on US PCE data, with EU GDP and German manufacturing orders also on the agenda.
nab4e47c85e.why: The PCE price index is the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, so it shapes expectations for US interest rates and global risk assets.

n0461c5924e.headline: DOTr, LTFRB hold off jeepney fare increase
n0461c5924e.summary: The LTFRB deferred a proposed P1 to P2 fare increase for traditional and modern jeepneys after diesel prices dropped significantly this week. The board announced the decision.
n0461c5924e.why: Jeepneys are the main public transport in many Philippine cities and run on diesel, so fuel costs drive fare policy. Fare decisions affect commuter costs and transport operator economics.

n71a366e3b1.headline: Canada added 54,000 jobs in November, unemployment rate drops to 6.5%: StatCan
n71a366e3b1.summary: Statistics Canada reported 54,000 jobs added in November and an unemployment rate of 6.5%. The economy added 181,000 jobs from September through November after a cooler labour market earlier in the year.
n71a366e3b1.why: Employment and unemployment data shape expectations for Bank of Canada interest rate decisions and the outlook for the Canadian economy.
n71a366e3b1.why_moved: The labour data showed job gains and a lower unemployment rate after a cool period tied to U.S. tariff uncertainty, which bears on the central bank's rate outlook.
